:::{#sol-linear-is-affine-practice}

Yes.
By @cor-linear-is-affine,
every [linear map](#def-linear-map) is an [affine map](#def-affine-map) with [offset](#def-affine-offset) $\vzero$.
Here

$$
f(\vx) = \sbmat{1 & -4} \vx + 0,
$$

with the $1 \times 2$ [matrix](#def-matrix) $\sbmat{1 & -4}$ and offset $0$.

:::
